witness.explanation: The contraction supplies a dimension factor that cancels the divisor d_rho.
witness.evidence: The single-vector formula has prefactor14400/d_rho. In Q^T J Q, contraction with J^{-1} contributes Tr(J^{-1}J)=d_rho. Thus the direct contracted coefficient map has prefactor(14400/d_rho)*d_rho=14400, independent of representation degree. The old code used ORDER*inverse(degree) modulo24001; the corrected code uses ORDER. Residual minor values consequently change from1400 and15799 to13280 and7143 modulo24001. The normalized Schur stage is unaffected.
